distancePolicy: Use per-stage official distances for normalization; do not import a single headline distance without topology context.

Smålandsleden overview says ca 300 km as a loop; municipalities/tourism say 44 mil/440 km; official HÖ1-HÖ23 stage pages total 428.6 km. Working interpretation: ca 300 km refers to the main loop, 44 mil refers to all branches/connectors.

mainLoop.description: HÖ2 plus HÖ4-HÖ17 form a closed loop from Skuruhatt via Valbacken, Lilla Bjälkerum, Ädelfors, Högarp, Lemnhult, Lindshammar, Ramkvilla, Asa, Hultsjö, Sävsjö, Forsa, Vikskvarn, Lövhult, Ränneborg, and back to Skuruhatt.

connectorsAndBranches.name: Västra Lägern-Skuruhatt connector
connectorsAndBranches.handling: connector/branch route group; do not flatten into the main loop

connectorsAndBranches.name: Valbacken-Mariannelund connector
connectorsAndBranches.handling: connector route group toward Mariannelund/Emilleden/Kalmar county context

topologyCaveats: Smålandsleden overview says 'three etapper' connect to other systems/counties, but the current HÖ18-HÖ23 west branch consists of six official stage pages. Treat this as ambiguous wording until the section synthesis confirms intended route-group modeling.
Older Eksjö municipal wording divides Höglandsleden into four parts/delleder, which does not directly match the current HÖ1-HÖ23 official stage numbering.

sourcePolicy: Use official Naturkartan per-stage GPX as canonical route geometry unless a section file gives a more specific repair instruction.
No official single whole-trail GPX/KML/GeoJSON was found in phase 1.
OSM Höglandsleden relations reference older PDFs and older naming; use only as supplemental geometry/context.
sectionSpecificInstructions: For HÖ18, use official title and GPX direction, not the slug, for section direction.
For HÖ16, use 24.1 km from the official info panel.
For HÖ23, official GPX is canonical; API v3.2 is simplified display-grade linework and direct KML/GeoJSON/JSON downloads were unavailable.
For HÖ23, use the HÖ23 official GPX or the research-only derived GeoJSON artifact for geometry planning; remove/tolerate the duplicate point during final normalization.
For HÖ23, OSM relation 15427025 spans Grönelund-Kärringabacka across HÖ22+HÖ23; do not import it as standalone HÖ23 without clipping/extraction.
normalizationActions: Assemble route groups from the topology in sectionCoverage.topologyForNormalization.
Preserve per-section source URLs, official display distance, computed GPX distance and endpoint gap notes from section packets.
Run endpoint continuity checks before route group generation; use tolerance where section research records near-identical but not coordinate-identical handoffs.
Generate candidate-only QA artifacts under this trail folder if visual review is needed.
unknowns: unknown/recheck: Exactly which municipalities and counties each stage traverses, especially HÖ10-HÖ11 around Asa/Kronoberg and HÖ23 around Kärringabacka/Gnosjö.
unknown/recheck: Whether official route groups should be modeled as main loop plus three connectors, main loop plus east/north/west branches, or another route-builder topology.

sourcePolicy: Import only section-file facilities with source-backed coordinates and clear public access/currentness status.
Model commercial, bookable or customer-only services as commercial/access metadata unless the section file explicitly says they are public trail facilities.
Do not infer drinking water from lakes, streams, shelters or private/bookable services.
deduplicationTargets: Skuruhatt/Skurugata shared endpoint facilities across HÖ1, HÖ2 and HÖ17.
Valbacken shared endpoint facilities across HÖ2, HÖ3 and HÖ4.
Ädelfors shared endpoint facilities across HÖ5 and HÖ6.
Högarp shared endpoint facilities across HÖ6 and HÖ7.
Vikskvarn shared endpoint facilities across HÖ14, HÖ15 and HÖ18.
Byarum/Grönelund/Skillingaryd and Åsafors shared facilities across HÖ20-HÖ23.
importWithCaveats: Official shelter, fireplace, toilet, parking, transit and water records from section files after dedupe and coordinate/currentness review.
Bookable or seasonal services only with opening/access caveats in descriptions.
Weak rural transit only as caveated access metadata, not as simple high-confidence endpoint transit.
pendingOrSuppress: For HÖ23, the OSM/TillSkogs lean-to at 57.4633969/13.8393272 should be suppressed from import until field or official verification; OSM history includes a DWG revert for undocumented import.
For HÖ23, Sörgården is private/customer lodging context only; do not import its parking or amenities as public trail facilities.
For HÖ23, no official on-route water/toilet/fireplace/food/waste/swimming/parking facility was found directly on the section beyond endpoint access metadata.
For HÖ23, no public potable water was found and official text warns of few rest places; carry enough water/food.
unknowns: unknown/recheck: Which official nearby facilities have exact coordinates and should be imported versus treated as access metadata, side trips, commercial services, or pending records.

staticRulePolicy: Use normalized-candidate/protected-area-overlays.research.json to scope protected-area restrictions by route/facility intersection before attaching them to section segments or facilities.
Use section-level protected-area notes from the research packets; do not apply whole-trail reserve warnings globally.
Represent water scarcity, unreliable natural water and unavailable public potable water as rule warnings or section notes rather than potable-water facilities.
liveCheckPolicy: Before publication or trip guidance, recheck live fire-ban status and post-Storm-Dave/current trail clearance.
Fire-ban status is volatile and must not be imported as static permission.
JLT Närtrafik should not be imported as general hiker shuttle access because it is resident/address-based prebooked rural demand transport.
ruleWarningsToCarry: Protected-area rules may override allemansrätten where the route or facility is proven to enter the protected area.
Several sections have weak/no potable water; carry enough water unless a verified managed source is imported.
Several endpoint and rural bus options are sparse, indirect or coordinate-pending; require current timetable verification.
unknowns: unknown/recheck: Whether any current closures, reroutes, forestry works, hunting-season advisories, water reliability warnings, or live fire restrictions affect individual stages.

blockers.details: No runtime data has been imported.
Whether official route groups should be modeled as main loop plus three connectors, main loop plus east/north/west branches, or another route-builder topology.
Protected-area, Natura 2000, water-protection and biotopskydd overlays are recorded in normalized-candidate/protected-area-overlays.research.json.
Live fire-ban/currentness, post-Storm-Dave clearance, transit schedules and water reliability must be rechecked before user-facing runtime import.
Shared endpoint clusters, commercial/customer-only services, weak transit and unverified water/shelter records need normalization review.

openDecisionsForUser.decision: Choose the route-builder topology for Höglandsleden.
openDecisionsForUser.whyItMatters: The official distance and stage structure only make sense if the app distinguishes the ca 300 km loop from branch/connector material.

openDecisionsForUser.decision: Decide whether official access trails such as Mariannelund-HÖ3, Sävsjö C, Hok station, Byarum kyrka, Skillingaryd station and Lyngemadens naturreservat should be first-class route groups or access metadata.
openDecisionsForUser.whyItMatters: They are mentioned officially, but should not be silently merged into HÖ section geometry.

openDecisionsForUser.decision: Decide app scope for bookable/commercial services and very weak rural transit.
openDecisionsForUser.whyItMatters: Several useful services exist, but importing them as ordinary public trail facilities would overstate access.

validationChecklist: JSON parse this handoff and every changed research file.
Verify all 23 expected section files exist and match officialSectionOrder.
Check every normalized section retains source URL, official distance, computed distance and transform notes.
Verify route group distances separately for main loop, HÖ1, HÖ3 and HÖ18-HÖ23 branch.
Run endpoint-gap checks at Skuruhatt, Valbacken, Vikskvarn, Byarum/Grönelund, Åsafors and Kärringabacka.
Run duplicate facility detection for every shared endpoint cluster listed in facilityPlan.deduplicationTargets.
Confirm no private/customer-only service is imported as a public facility.
Review protected-area-overlays.research.json before importing static reserve/cultural-reserve rule warnings and repeat overlays if route geometry or source boundaries change.
Recheck live fire bans, current trail clearance, transit schedules and water reliability before runtime publication.
Keep all outputs research-only until the user explicitly requests runtime integration.
